title: Survival Analyses Protocol for Wolf Management and Livestock Protection
author: Francisco Santiago-Ávila
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.jsscnee
materials: ***Set data as survival time for PWP-GT model
*Graphing smoothed hazard estimates (hazard ratio) by group

steps.title: Configure Stata Environment
steps.instruction: Initialize the Stata 14 environment with the required memory and display settings.

substeps.instruction: Turn off the 'more' prompt permanently (set more off, permanently)

steps.title: Prepare Survival Analysis Dataset
steps.instruction: Organize the dataset using the following variables for spatial scale survival analyses.

substeps.instruction: Assign ID_TRS_yr as the identifier for each area-year combination
Assign Interv_dummy as the intervention type (0 for ‘non-lethal’, 1 for ‘lethal’)
Assign Delay_in_yrstop_time as the time to recurrent event in days or censoring
Assign status_event as the failure binary variable (1 if recurrent event, 0 if censored)
Assign yr_stratum as the order of recurrent events within a particular area-year

steps.title: Perform Survival Analysis
steps.instruction: Execute the statistical tests to analyze survival functions and hazards.

substeps.instruction: Perform a Log-rank test to test the equality of survival functions by group
Add a time-varying covariate to account for proportional hazard assumption violations
Calculate the correlation between the delay between incidents and wolves killed for the 'Lethal' group only
